               長至1個月。

items.label: Peramivir 懷孕
items.summary: FDA 懷孕用藥分類為 C 級；於判斷治療上的有益性高於危險性時才可投與，懷孕期投與之相關安全性尚未確立。

refs.quote: FDA懷孕用藥分類為C級。

items.label: Peramivir 哺乳
items.summary: 投與中應避免哺餵母乳。

refs.quote: 投與中應避免哺餵母乳

items.label: Favipiravir（Avigan）核准適應症限於新型／再現大流行流感
items.summary: PMDA 核准的適應症為治療新型或再現大流行流感病毒感染（限於其他抗流感病毒藥物無效或效果不足之病例）。

refs.quote:
Treatment of novel or re-emerging pandemic influenza virus infections (limited to cases in which
other influenza antiviral drugs are ineffective or not sufficiently effective).

items.label: Favipiravir 季節性流感療效未獲確認
items.summary: PMDA 審查結論：favipiravir 治療季節性 A 型或 B 型流感病毒感染的療效尚未獲得確認，僅在美國有臨床療效的初步顯示。

refs.quote:
the efficacy of Avigan (favipiravir) in patients with seasonal influenza A or B virus
infection has not been confirmed, and only the clinical efficacy has been suggested in the US.

items.label: Favipiravir 核准劑量
items.summary: 成人常用劑量：第 1 天口服 1600 mg 每日兩次，第 2 至第 5 天口服 600 mg 每日兩次，總治療期間為 5 天。

refs.quote:
The usual adult dosage is 1600 mg of favipiravir administered orally twice daily on Day 1,
followed by 600 mg orally twice daily from Day 2 to Day 5. The total treatment duration should
be 5 days.

items.label: Favipiravir 孕婦禁用
items.summary: 由於致畸胎風險，孕婦或可能懷孕之婦女應列為禁忌；有生育能力之女性與男性須採取避孕措施。

refs.quote:
favipiravir should be contraindicated for women who are pregnant or may possibly
be pregnant, and women of childbearing potential and men whose partner is of childbearing
potential should be advised to use contraception.
